description:
Comfortable Everyday Riding with an Easy Step-Through Design

Whether you're riding through your neighborhood, commuting across town, or enjoying a relaxing ride on bike paths, the Traveler 21-Speed Step-Through Mountain Bike is designed to make everyday cycling comfortable and easy.
Its lightweight aluminum step-through frame allows riders to get on and off the bike with less effort while maintaining the stability and versatility of a recreational mountain bike. Combined with a Shimano 21-speed drivetrain and front suspension fork, the Traveler is well suited for paved roads, bike paths, parks, and light gravel trails.
Designed for recreational riding, the Traveler offers a comfortable riding position and dependable performance for everyday adventures.

Easy Step-Through Aluminum Frame
The lightweight aluminum step-through frame makes mounting and dismounting easier, especially during frequent stops around town or while commuting.
Its upright riding position promotes comfort while providing confident handling for riders of various experience levels.

Shimano 21-Speed Drivetrain
The Shimano 21-speed drivetrain offers a wide gear range for climbing gentle hills, riding on flat roads, and adapting to changing terrain.
Shimano EZ-FIRE PLUS shifters provide smooth, intuitive shifting that is easy for beginners while delivering dependable performance for experienced riders.

Front Suspension for Everyday Comfort
Uneven pavement, gravel paths, expansion joints, and small bumps are common during everyday rides.
The suspension fork helps absorb these impacts, creating a smoother and more comfortable riding experience.

Reliable Tektro V-Brakes
Front and rear Tektro alloy V-brakes provide dependable stopping performance with simple maintenance.
Whether you're riding through the neighborhood or enjoying a weekend ride, the braking system delivers predictable control.

26-Inch Wheels Built for Recreational Riding
The 26-inch wheels provide responsive handling and confident maneuverability for recreational mountain biking and everyday riding.
The 26 × 1.95-inch tires offer a practical balance of rolling efficiency, traction, and durability across pavement, gravel, and light dirt trails.

Ideal For
The Traveler Step-Through is a practical choice for riders looking for one bike that can comfortably handle:

The Traveler is designed for recreational riding and light off-road use. It is not intended for technical mountain bike trails, aggressive downhill riding, jumps, or extreme terrain.
